definitions.recency: Days from the last retained purchase to the day after the last date in the dataset.
definitions.monetary: Historical retained line sales proxy in GBP; it is not profit or predictive lifetime value.
definitions.churn: A project-defined snapshot: more than 90 days inactive. At Risk is 60–90 days inclusive.
definitions.cohort_retention: Observed repeat purchases within 12 months after the acquisition month. Future unobserved months are absent, not zero.
definitions.privacy_suppression: Country-level RFM/status groups with fewer than five shoppers, cohorts with fewer than five shoppers, and non-zero cohort cells below five returning shoppers are omitted.
